requirement_text: It shall not be necessary to scrub that area used to store telemetry data.
requirement_text_raw: It shall (3.3.8.16) not be necessary to scrub that area used to store telemetry data.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want no need to scrub the area used to store telemetry data, so that it can be reused directly.
technical_task: Allow the telemetry storage area to be reused without scrubbing.
acceptance_criteria: Given the telemetry storage area, when it is reused, then no scrub step is required.
Given the telemetry storage area, when telemetry is written, then it works without prior scrubbing.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "That area" refers to an earlier requirement that is not included.

requirement_text: Is there no vehicle traction standby release from level2 for a time longer than a calibratable time (1 second) after rising edge of T50, then the vehicle traction standby release (FBA_E2) will be irreversibly deactivated for the current driving cycle and an error will be stored in failure memory.
user_story: As a vehicle engineer, I want the vehicle traction standby release irreversibly deactivated for the driving cycle, with an error stored, when no release comes from level2 within the calibratable time of 1 second after the rising edge of T50, so that a faulty release is not used.
technical_task: Deactivate the vehicle traction standby release (FBA_E2) irreversibly for the current driving cycle and store an error in failure memory when there is no standby release from level2 for longer than the calibratable time of 1 second after the rising edge of T50.
acceptance_criteria: Given no vehicle traction standby release from level2 for longer than the calibratable time of 1 second after the rising edge of T50, when the time has passed, then FBA_E2 is irreversibly deactivated for the current driving cycle.
Given the same condition, when FBA_E2 is deactivated, then an error is stored in failure memory.

requirement_text: In the list of in transit lab procedures the Lab Technician can update the status to received when the sample has been received in his or her lab.
requirement_text_raw: In the list of in transit lab procedures   the Lab Technician can update the status to received when the sample has been received in his or her lab.
user_story: As a lab technician, I want to update the status of an in transit lab procedure to received when the sample arrives in my lab, so that its progress is tracked.
technical_task: Allow a Lab Technician to set the status of an in transit lab procedure to received once the sample has been received.
acceptance_criteria: Given a lab procedure in the in transit list, when the Lab Technician updates its status to received, then the status is saved.
Given a received sample, when the list is viewed, then the procedure shows the received status.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to search for videos using keywords or other criteria.
user_story: As a user, I want to search videos by keywords or other criteria, so that I can find them easily.
technical_task: Provide video search that accepts keywords and further search criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Given a keyword, when the user searches, then matching videos are listed.
Given another search criterion, when the user searches, then matching videos are listed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The other criteria are not listed.

requirement_text: Employee shall receive quick notifications for prompt action.
rationale: "Quick" and "prompt" are not measurable and the notification trigger is missing.
clarification_questions: What counts as a "quick" notification?
What action is meant by "prompt action"?

requirement_text: User shall commit all data storage for user variables to the database at the time of entry for reliability.
user_story: As a user, I want all data for my user variables committed to the database when I enter it, so that nothing is lost.
technical_task: Write user variable data to the database at the moment of entry.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user enters data for a user variable, when it is entered, then it is committed to the database immediately.
Given a system restart after entry, when the data is read, then the entered data is still present.

requirement_text: User shall be able to connect via IP address.
user_story: As a user, I want to connect via an IP address, so that I can reach the system directly.
technical_task: Allow connections to be made using an IP address.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid IP address, when the user connects with it, then the connection is established.
Given an invalid IP address, when the user tries to connect, then the connection is not established.

requirement_text: The solution should prevent access to EMR applications or EMR data to all non-authenticated principals.
user_story: As a security officer, I want EMR applications and data to be blocked for all non-authenticated principals, so that only identified users get access.
technical_task: Deny every non-authenticated principal access to EMR applications and EMR data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a non-authenticated principal, when the principal opens an EMR application, then access is denied.
Given a non-authenticated principal, when the principal requests EMR data, then access is denied.

requirement_text: User shall be able to participate in one-to-one and group video chats.
user_story: As a user, I want to take part in one-to-one and group video chats, so that I can talk to others face to face.
technical_task: Support video chat between two users and among a group of users.
acceptance_criteria: Given two users, when they start a video chat, then they can see and hear each other.
Given a group of users, when they start a group video chat, then all participants take part.

requirement_text: Applicants' accessibility shall be ensured in all possible ways.
rationale: "In all possible ways" is not measurable.
clarification_questions: What accessibility standard or measurable criteria apply for applicants?
What does "in all possible ways" cover?

requirement_text: Passwords must meet specific criteria, including a minimum length of 8 characters, at least one uppercase character, one digit, and one special symbol.
user_story: As a security officer, I want passwords to have at least 8 characters, an uppercase character, a digit and a special symbol, so that they are hard to guess.
technical_task: Enforce a password policy requiring a minimum length of 8 characters, at least one uppercase character, one digit and one special symbol.
acceptance_criteria: Given a password with at least 8 characters, an uppercase character, a digit and a special symbol, when the user sets it, then it is accepted.
Given a password that lacks any of these elements, when the user sets it, then it is rejected.

requirement_text: The system shall enforce data privacy and confidentiality measures to protect sensitive information handled within the command-line interface.
user_story: As a security officer, I want privacy and confidentiality measures for sensitive information handled in the command-line interface, so that data is protected.
technical_task: Apply data privacy and confidentiality controls to sensitive information used in the command-line interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive information is handled in the command-line interface, when it is displayed, then confidentiality measures are applied.
Given sensitive information in the command-line interface, when an unauthorized person tries to access it, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The measures are not listed.

requirement_text: Users must be prompted to change their PIN on first use for security.
user_story: As a new user, I want to be prompted to change my PIN on first use, so that my account is secure.
technical_task: Force a PIN change prompt the first time a user uses a PIN.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user using the PIN for the first time, when the user signs in, then the user is prompted to change the PIN.
Given a user who has already changed the PIN, when the user signs in, then no change prompt is shown.

requirement_text: The system shall perform basic operations in less than 2 seconds.
user_story: As a user, I want basic operations to finish in less than 2 seconds, so that the system feels fast.
technical_task: Complete basic operations in under 2 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a basic operation, when the user performs it, then it completes in less than 2 seconds.
Given an operation that takes 2 seconds or more, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which operations are "basic" is not listed.

requirement_text: System shall maintain response time under 100 milliseconds for normal workload conditions.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to respond in under 100 milliseconds under normal workload, so that it feels responsive.
technical_task: Keep system response time under 100 milliseconds for normal workload conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a normal workload, when a request is made, then the response time is under 100 milliseconds.
Given a normal workload over a period of use, when response times are measured, then they stay under 100 milliseconds.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What counts as a normal workload is not defined.

requirement_text: In all FCP IBIT cases, provided the hardware state permits, the FTSS shall log the error and report it in the X-38 telemetry stream.
requirement_text_raw: In all FCP IBIT cases, provided the hardware state permits, the FTSS shall (3.3.2.29) log the error and report it in the X-38 telemetry stream.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS to log and report each FCP IBIT error in the X-38 telemetry stream when the hardware state permits, so that faults are visible.
technical_task: Log the error in all FCP IBIT cases and report it in the X-38 telemetry stream, provided the hardware state permits.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCP IBIT error and a hardware state that permits it, when it occurs, then the FTSS logs the error.
Given the same error and hardware state, when it occurs, then the FTSS reports it in the X-38 telemetry stream.

requirement_text: FTSS shall only allow a single task residing on each specified virtual group to "open" the respective end of the pipe.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall [SRS230] only allow a single task residing on each specified virtual group to "open" the respective end of the pipe.
user_story: As a software developer, I want FTSS to allow only a single task on each specified virtual group to open its end of a pipe, so that pipe ends have one owner.
technical_task: Allow only one task residing on a specified virtual group to open the respective end of the pipe.
acceptance_criteria: Given a pipe end in a specified virtual group, when a single task opens it, then the open succeeds.
Given a pipe end already opened by a task in that virtual group, when a second task tries to open the same end, then the open is not allowed.

requirement_text: The system shall provide textual descriptions or alternative functionalities for all non-text media like images and videos.
user_story: As a user who cannot see images or videos, I want textual descriptions or alternative functionalities for all non-text media, so that I can access the content.
technical_task: Provide a textual description or an alternative function for every image and video.
acceptance_criteria: Given an image, when it is displayed, then a textual description or alternative function is available.
Given a video, when it is displayed, then a textual description or alternative function is available.
rationale: Role assumed: user needing accessibility support.

requirement_text: System shall offer easy access to the blog for user consumption.
user_story: As a reader, I want easy access to the blog, so that I can read posts.
technical_task: Link the blog from a prominent place so users can open it directly.
acceptance_criteria: Given the main page, when a user looks for the blog, then a link to the blog is available.
Given the link, when a user selects it, then the blog opens.
rationale: Role assumed: reader. "Easy" is interpreted as a direct link.

requirement_text: The system shall maintain a memory buffer to store lag frames and track the status of each record in the buffer.
user_story: As a software developer, I want a memory buffer that stores lag frames and tracks the status of each record in it, so that lag frames are not lost.
technical_task: Maintain a memory buffer holding lag frames and track the status of every record in the buffer.
acceptance_criteria: Given lag frames arrive, when they are processed, then they are stored in the memory buffer.
Given records in the memory buffer, when their state changes, then the status of each record is tracked.

requirement_text: The number with a '-' in the 'Prv' column indicates the number of insurance companies for which this invoice is awaiting payment.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want a number with a '-' in the Prv column to show how many insurance companies the invoice still awaits payment from, so that I can follow open claims.
technical_task: Show, in the Prv column, a number marked with '-' that counts the insurance companies from which the invoice awaits payment.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invoice awaiting payment from insurance companies, when the Prv column is displayed, then it shows a number with a '-'.
Given the number, when it is read, then it indicates how many insurance companies the invoice awaits payment from.

requirement_text: The MultiMahjongServer will support an architecture whereby all Computer Opponents (CO) required will reside on it instead of on the MultiMahjongClient programs.
user_story: As a player, I want all Computer Opponents to run on the MultiMahjongServer instead of on my client, so that my client stays light.
technical_task: Run every required Computer Opponent (CO) on the MultiMahjongServer rather than in the MultiMahjongClient programs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a game needing Computer Opponents, when it starts, then all required Computer Opponents run on the MultiMahjongServer.
Given a MultiMahjongClient, when the game runs, then no Computer Opponent runs in the client.
rationale: Role assumed: player. The benefit is inferred.

requirement_text: Asymmetric I/O calls shall not be allowed to induce a large enough skew to force the FCPs to desynchronize.
requirement_text_raw: Asymmetric I/O calls shall (3.3.11.3) not be allowed to induce a large enough skew to force the FCPs to desynchronize.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want asymmetric I/O calls prevented from causing skew that desynchronizes the FCPs, so that the FCPs stay in sync.
technical_task: Constrain asymmetric I/O calls so that they cannot create enough skew to make the FCPs desynchronize.
acceptance_criteria: Given an asymmetric I/O call, when it executes, then it does not induce enough skew to desynchronize the FCPs.
Given the FCPs, when asymmetric I/O calls are made, then they remain synchronized.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. How much skew is "large enough" is not stated.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall give tasks priority values according to their rate - the higher the rate, the higher the priority.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS027] give tasks priority values according to their rate - the higher the rate, the higher the priority.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scheduler to give higher priority to tasks with higher rates, so that faster tasks run first.
technical_task: Assign task priority values in the scheduler according to task rate, with a higher rate giving a higher priority.
acceptance_criteria: Given two tasks with different rates, when the scheduler assigns priorities, then the task with the higher rate gets the higher priority.
Given tasks with the same rate, when the scheduler assigns priorities, then they get the same priority value.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: User shall be able to search for restaurants by price range (minimum and maximum) with results displayed in a list view by default.
user_story: As a diner, I want to search for restaurants by minimum and maximum price, with results in a list by default, so that I find places in my budget.
technical_task: Add a price range search with a minimum and a maximum and show the results in a list view by default.
acceptance_criteria: Given a minimum and a maximum price, when the user searches, then restaurants within the range are shown.
Given search results, when they are displayed without changing the view, then they appear in a list view.

requirement_text: User shall/will be able to integrate with Netbeans IDE 7.2.1 for Java development and MySQL Query Browser for database management.
user_story: As a developer, I want the application to integrate with Netbeans IDE 7.2.1 for Java development and MySQL Query Browser for database management, so that I can use my tools.
technical_task: Support integration with Netbeans IDE 7.2.1 for Java development and with MySQL Query Browser for database management.
acceptance_criteria: Given Netbeans IDE 7.2.1, when a developer uses it for Java development, then the application integrates with it.
Given MySQL Query Browser, when a developer uses it for database management, then the application integrates with it.

requirement_text: The system shall be expected to manage the nursing program curriculum and class/clinical scheduling for a minimum of 5 years.
requirement_text_raw: The system shall be expected to manage the nursing program curriculum and class/clinical scheduling for a minimum of 5 years.'
user_story: As a nursing program administrator, I want the system to manage the curriculum and class and clinical scheduling for at least 5 years, so that the program can plan ahead.
technical_task: Hold and manage the nursing program curriculum and class/clinical scheduling data for a minimum of 5 years.
acceptance_criteria: Given curriculum and scheduling data, when it is stored, then it can be managed for a minimum of 5 years.
Given data from up to 5 years ago, when the administrator opens it, then it is still available.

requirement_text: The system shall ensure multi-lingual support, with English, Turkish, Finnish, and Italian as supported languages due to replication partnerships.
user_story: As an international user, I want the system in English, Turkish, Finnish and Italian, so that partners in each language can use it.
technical_task: Provide multi-lingual support for English, Turkish, Finnish and Italian.
acceptance_criteria: Given the language setting, when a user picks Turkish, Finnish or Italian, then the system is shown in that language.
Given the language setting, when a user picks English, then the system is shown in English.
rationale: Role assumed: international user. The replication partnerships are the stated reason.

requirement_text: Memory scrubbing shall be executed without interfering with normal execution of applications tasks.
requirement_text_raw: Memory scrubbing shall (3.3.8.5) be executed without interfering with normal execution of applications tasks.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want memory scrubbing to run without interfering with the normal execution of application tasks, so that tasks are not disturbed.
technical_task: Run memory scrubbing so that it does not interfere with the normal execution of application tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given memory scrubbing is running, when application tasks execute, then they execute normally.
Given memory scrubbing is running, when it is compared with a run without scrubbing, then application task execution is not interfered with.

requirement_text: System shall display available astrologers for interaction based on user input.
user_story: As a user, I want to see available astrologers based on my input, so that I can choose one to talk to.
technical_task: Display the astrologers who are available and match the user's input.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's input, when the user searches, then available astrologers matching it are displayed.
Given an astrologer who is not available, when the user searches, then the astrologer is not displayed.

requirement_text: See SPEC LV 123 (`` Reference List for Client Specifications '' [HVBATT R-111]) for details.
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced Reference List for Client Specifications require?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: System shall integrate with existing University systems such as LDAP for cost-effective administration.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want the system to integrate with existing University systems such as LDAP, so that administration costs less.
technical_task: Connect the system to existing University systems, for example LDAP, to reuse their administration.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing University system such as LDAP, when the system is configured to use it, then the integration works.
Given the integration is in place, when an administrator manages users, then the existing University system is used for it.
rationale: Role assumed: system administrator. "Cost-effective" is not measured; the criteria check only the integration.

requirement_text: When the IBIT is complete, the FTSS in the channels that are part of the fault masking group shall report the results of IBIT for all Radstone boards to the application software for telemetry.
requirement_text_raw: When the IBIT is complete, the FTSS in the channels that are part of the fault masking group shall [SRS239] report the results of IBIT for all Radstone boards to the application software for telemetry.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FTSS in the fault masking group channels to report the IBIT results for all Radstone boards to the application software when IBIT is complete, so that results reach telemetry.
technical_task: When IBIT completes, have the FTSS in each channel of the fault masking group report the IBIT results for all Radstone boards to the application software for telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Given IBIT is complete, when the FTSS in a channel that is part of the fault masking group reports, then the results of IBIT for all Radstone boards are sent to the application software.
Given the reported results, when the application builds telemetry, then they can be included in the telemetry.

requirement_text: User shall anticipate API responses in less than 2.5 seconds to maintain seamless application functionality.
user_story: As a user, I want API responses in less than 2.5 seconds, so that the application works without noticeable delay.
technical_task: Keep API response times under 2.5 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API request, when the response is measured, then it arrives in less than 2.5 seconds.
Given a response that takes 2.5 seconds or longer, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Typical load is not stated.

requirement_text: Selecting multiple encounters will allow you to generate batch files for many claims at once.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want to select multiple encounters and generate batch files for many claims at once, so that billing is faster.
technical_task: Allow several encounters to be selected and produce batch files for their claims in one action.
acceptance_criteria: Given several selected encounters, when the clerk generates batch files, then batch files for those claims are produced.
Given no selected encounters, when the clerk generates batch files, then no batch file is produced.

requirement_text: Time Management shall provide a utility timer.
requirement_text_raw: Time Management shall (3.3.10.23) provide a utility timer.
user_story: As a software developer, I want Time Management to provide a utility timer, so that I can measure intervals.
technical_task: Offer a utility timer from Time Management.
acceptance_criteria: Given Time Management, when an application requests a utility timer, then a utility timer is provided.
Given a utility timer, when it is used, then it can measure elapsed time.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall initiate transient NE recovery to restore Byzantine-resilient communications, if alignment is permitted. (Note that NEFU recovery does not depend on whether alignment is permitted.)
requirement_text_raw: Redundancy Management shall [SRS129] initiate transient NE recovery to restore Byzantine-resilient communications, if alignment is permitted. (Note that NEFU recovery does not depend on whether alignment is permitted.)
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to start transient NE recovery when alignment is permitted, so that Byzantine-resilient communications are restored.
technical_task: Initiate transient NE recovery in Redundancy Management to restore Byzantine-resilient communications if alignment is permitted, while NEFU recovery is independent of that permission.
acceptance_criteria: Given alignment is permitted, when a transient NE recovery is needed, then Redundancy Management initiates it.
Given alignment is not permitted, when an NEFU recovery is needed, then it is still performed.

requirement_text: The system shall provide users with a list of selectable symptoms.
user_story: As a patient, I want a list of symptoms to choose from, so that I can describe how I feel.
technical_task: Display a list of selectable symptoms.
acceptance_criteria: Given the symptom list, when the user opens it, then selectable symptoms are shown.
Given the symptom list, when the user selects a symptom, then it is marked as chosen.

requirement_text: The system shall be designed for extensibility, maintainability, and open-source release.
rationale: "Extensibility" and "maintainability" are not measurable and the release is not described.
clarification_questions: What makes the design extensible and maintainable in testable terms?
What must be done for the open-source release (license, repository)?

requirement_text: After closing the contactors this time is set to zero.
rationale: The sentence is a fragment that refers to "this time" without saying which one.
clarification_questions: What "time" is set to zero and which contactors are meant?
When exactly does the reset happen?

requirement_text: System shall maintain data elements and rules up to date.
rationale: "Data elements and rules" and "up to date" are not specified.
clarification_questions: Which data elements and rules must be kept up to date?
How often and by whom?

requirement_text: The system shall allow authorized users to update the directory.
user_story: As an authorized user, I want to update the directory, so that its entries stay current.
technical_task: Allow authorized users to change directory entries.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized user, when the user updates the directory, then the change is saved.
Given a user who is not authorized, when the user tries to update the directory, then the update is refused.

requirement_text: Clients shall be able to change their password.
user_story: As a client, I want to change my password, so that I can keep my account secure.
technical_task: Offer a password change function for clients.
acceptance_criteria: Given a signed-in client, when the client enters a new password and confirms, then the password is changed.
Given the password has changed, when the client logs in again, then the new password is required.

requirement_text: The signals state 1 equal TRUE has to be transmitted if the `` distance within ego lane '' is fulfilled sufficiently for a stationary object, independent of whether it is the object with the lowest distance or an object with larger distance or a hidden object.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the signal state to be 1 (TRUE) whenever the distance within ego lane is sufficiently fulfilled for a stationary object, so that any such object is flagged.
technical_task: Transmit the signal with state 1 equal TRUE when the "distance within ego lane" condition is sufficiently met for a stationary object, regardless of whether it is the object with the lowest distance, an object with larger distance or a hidden object.
acceptance_criteria: Given a stationary object that sufficiently fulfils the distance within ego lane, when the signal is evaluated, then it is transmitted with state 1 equal TRUE.
Given the object is not the one with the lowest distance, or is a hidden object, when the condition is fulfilled, then the signal is still transmitted with state 1.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. "Sufficiently" is not defined in the requirement.

requirement_text: Special fit bolt will be used for mounting.
user_story: As a mechanical engineer, I want special fit bolts used for mounting, so that the mounting is accurate.
technical_task: Use special fit bolts for mounting.
acceptance_criteria: Given the mounting, when it is assembled, then special fit bolts are used.
Given the finished assembly, when it is inspected, then no standard bolts are used for the mounting.
rationale: Role assumed: mechanical engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: System shall be easily updatable for fixes and patches.
rationale: "Easily" is subjective and no update process or target is given.
clarification_questions: What does "easily updatable" mean (time, effort, downtime)?
How are fixes and patches delivered?

requirement_text: The system shall provide progress indicators during the cloning process.
user_story: As a user, I want progress indicators while cloning runs, so that I know how far it has come.
technical_task: Show progress indicators during the cloning process.
acceptance_criteria: Given the cloning process is running, when the user looks at the screen, then a progress indicator is displayed.
Given the cloning process finishes, when it completes, then the progress indicator shows completion.

requirement_text: System shall be designed with better component design to ensure better performance during peak times.
rationale: "Better component design" and "better performance" are comparative and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What is a "better" component design than what baseline?
What performance target applies at peak times?

requirement_text: User shall be able to access the manager homepage after login.
user_story: As a manager, I want to open the manager homepage after logging in, so that I reach my tools.
technical_task: Direct a user who logs in to the manager homepage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a manager logs in, when login succeeds, then the manager homepage can be accessed.
Given a user without manager rights logs in, when login succeeds, then the manager homepage is not accessible.
rationale: Role assumed: manager. The second criterion is an assumption about who may see the page.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to export data to other formats (e.g., CSV, PDF).
user_story: As a user, I want to export data to other formats such as CSV or PDF, so that I can use it elsewhere.
technical_task: Offer export of data to formats including CSV and PDF.
acceptance_criteria: Given data in the system, when the user exports it as CSV, then a CSV file is produced.
Given data in the system, when the user exports it as PDF, then a PDF file is produced.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "E.g." means other formats may exist.

requirement_text: Patients can also be billed and their payments recorded.
requirement_text_raw: Patients can also be billed  and their payments recorded.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want to bill patients and record their payments, so that accounts are accurate.
technical_task: Provide billing of patients and recording of their payments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with a charge, when the clerk bills the patient, then the bill is created.
Given a bill, when the patient pays, then the payment is recorded.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to add or make changes to the Subject Name.
user_story: As a user, I want to add or change the Subject Name, so that subjects are labelled correctly.
technical_task: Allow the Subject Name to be entered and edited.
acceptance_criteria: Given a subject, when the user adds a Subject Name, then it is saved.
Given a subject with a Subject Name, when the user changes it, then the new name is saved.

requirement_text: The solution should prepare a report of a patient ‘s immunization history upon request for appropriate authorities such as Public Health organization.
user_story: As a public health official, I want a patient's immunization history report on request, so that authorities can review it.
technical_task: Generate a report of a patient's immunization history on request for appropriate authorities.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient's immunization history, when an authority requests a report, then it is generated.
Given the report, when it is opened, then it lists the immunizations of that patient.

requirement_text: All conductive parts of the housing have to be connected electrically conductive in distances not larger than 5 cm.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want all conductive parts of the housing electrically connected at distances of at most 5 cm, so that grounding is continuous.
technical_task: Connect all conductive housing parts electrically with a distance of not more than 5 cm between connections.
acceptance_criteria: Given the conductive parts of the housing, when connections are inspected, then every part is electrically connected.
Given two connection points, when the distance is measured, then it is not larger than 5 cm.

requirement_text: System shall ensure that transactions reflect accurately in databases without any data loss.
user_story: As an account holder, I want transactions to be reflected accurately in the databases without data loss, so that my records are correct.
technical_task: Write every transaction to the databases completely and accurately.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction, when it completes, then it is reflected accurately in the databases.
Given a series of transactions, when they are all complete, then none of their data is missing from the databases.

requirement_text: System provides a listing of privileged account holders within the System hosting environment.
user_story: As a system auditor, I want a listing of privileged account holders within the hosting environment, so that I know who has elevated access.
technical_task: Generate a list of privileged account holders in the System hosting environment.
acceptance_criteria: Given privileged accounts in the hosting environment, when the listing is requested, then all privileged account holders are listed.
Given a new privileged account, when the listing is requested again, then the new holder is included.

requirement_text: System shall restrict users from viewing other users' details to ensure privacy and security.
user_story: As a user, I want other users to be unable to open my personal details, so that my privacy is kept.
technical_task: Deny a user access to the detail pages of other users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user viewing their own details, when the page is opened, then the details are shown.
Given a user trying to open another user's details, when the page is requested, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Exceptions for administrators are not mentioned.

requirement_text: The supplier has to agree to details of geometry with the client after component awarding.
user_story: As a client, I want the supplier to agree the details of geometry with me after the component is awarded, so that the geometry meets my needs.
technical_task: Have the supplier agree the details of the component's geometry with the client after the component is awarded.
acceptance_criteria: Given the component has been awarded, when the supplier prepares the geometry details, then they are agreed with the client.
Given the agreed geometry details, when they are reviewed, then the client has agreed to them.

requirement_text: User shall perform weekly roster of employees.
user_story: As a manager, I want to prepare a weekly roster of employees, so that shifts are planned.
technical_task: Provide weekly roster creation for employees.
acceptance_criteria: Given employees, when the user prepares a weekly roster, then the roster is saved.
Given a saved weekly roster, when it is opened, then it shows the employees' assignments.
rationale: Role assumed: manager; the requirement says user.

requirement_text: User shall be able to access the control panel based on their role as administrator, employer, or job seeker.
user_story: As a user, I want to open the control panel according to my role as administrator, employer or job seeker, so that I see the functions that suit my role.
technical_task: Provide a control panel whose access and content depend on whether the user is an administrator, an employer or a job seeker.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with the role administrator, employer or job seeker, when the user opens the control panel, then the panel for that role is shown.
Given a user without any of these roles, when the user tries to open the control panel, then access is denied.
rationale: The three roles are stated in the requirement. The second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: Users shall select the relevant performa category, fill the form, and submit it.
user_story: As a user, I want to select the relevant performa category, fill in the form and submit it, so that my performa is recorded.
technical_task: Provide a performa form with a category selection and a submit action.
acceptance_criteria: Given the performa page, when the user selects a category, then the matching form is shown.
Given the filled form, when the user submits it, then it is submitted.

requirement_text: When the radio is first powered on, the language that appears on the display shall be the default one set by the national railway. (M) Select mobile radio network.
requirement_text_raw:
When the radio is first powered on, the language that appears on the display shall be 
the default one set by the national railway. (M) 
Select mobile radio network.
user_story: As a railway driver, I want the display language to be the default one set by the national railway when the radio is first powered on, and to select the mobile radio network, so that the radio is ready to use.
technical_task: Show the display in the language the national railway set as default when the radio is first powered on, and offer selection of the mobile radio network.
acceptance_criteria: Given the radio is powered on for the first time, when the display starts, then it uses the default language set by the national railway.
Given the radio is powered on, when the user opens network settings, then a mobile radio network can be selected.
rationale: Role assumed: railway driver. The "(M)" tag is kept out of the behaviour.

requirement_text: The website shall not be offensive to religious or ethnic groups.
requirement_text_raw: The website shall not be offensive to religious or ethnic groups.'
clarification_questions: Which standard defines "offensive" to religious or ethnic groups?
How is the content to be reviewed?

requirement_text: This allows you to easily spot many types of errors such as appointments with missing encounters encounters with missing appointments missing charges and authorizations or justifications that are required but not done.
requirement_text_raw: This allows you to easily spot many types of errors  such as appointments with missing encounters  encounters with missing appointments  missing charges  and authorizations or justifications that are required but not done.
rationale: The sentence describes a benefit of an unnamed feature and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which feature is "this" and what must it do?
Is this a requirement or a description of a benefit?

requirement_text: The system should avoid becoming overloaded and should maintain optimal performance even under peak load conditions.
clarification_questions: What load counts as "overloaded" and what is "optimal performance"?
What response time and capacity apply at peak?

requirement_text: The list of available follow up actions for a given dispute case must be filtered by the status of the case and the access level of the user.
user_story: As a case handler, I want the follow-up actions for a dispute case to be filtered by the case status and my access level, so that I only see actions I may take.
technical_task: Filter the list of available follow-up actions for a dispute case by the status of the case and the access level of the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dispute case with a given status, when the list of follow-up actions is shown, then only actions available for that status are listed.
Given a user with a given access level, when the list of follow-up actions is shown, then only actions allowed for that access level are listed.

requirement_text: Further details for the control measures of the HV components in case of an interlock event and the timing shall be designed according to the specification of the OEM.
rationale: The sentence only points to an external specification and gives no content.
clarification_questions: What control measures are required for the HV components in case of an interlock event?
What timing values apply, since the OEM specification is not included?

requirement_text: The system shall provide the ability for authorized administrators to assign restrictions or privileges to users or groups.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to assign restrictions or privileges to users or groups, so that access is controlled.
technical_task: Allow authorized administrators to assign restrictions and privileges to individual users and to groups.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized administrator, when the administrator assigns a privilege to a user, then the privilege applies to that user.
Given an authorized administrator, when the administrator assigns a restriction to a group, then it applies to the group's members.

requirement_text: The failed channel, provided it is recoverable, shall be recovered in less than 1.5 minutes.
requirement_text_raw: The failed channel, provided it is recoverable, shall (3.1.15) be recovered in less than 1.5 minutes.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a recoverable failed channel recovered in less than 1.5 minutes, so that capacity returns quickly.
technical_task: Recover a failed channel, if it is recoverable, within less than 1.5 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failed channel that is recoverable, when recovery runs, then it completes in less than 1.5 minutes.
Given a failed channel that is not recoverable, when recovery is attempted, then this time limit does not apply.

requirement_text: Selected articles from the chancellor’s office daily communications distribution, fed to RSS subscribers on the Get Real site. This feature requires X hours per week of web design resource for editing the URLs to the DSS feed.
rationale: The text contains a placeholder ("X hours") and mixes a feature description with a resource note.
clarification_questions: How many hours per week of web design resource are needed ("X")?
Which behaviour is required of the system beyond feeding articles to RSS subscribers?

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to perform staff reviews to validate application compliance with zoning ordinances.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to carry out staff reviews, so that applications are checked against zoning ordinances.
technical_task: Provide a staff review function that validates application compliance with zoning ordinances.
acceptance_criteria: Given an application, when a staff member performs a staff review, then compliance with zoning ordinances is validated.
Given a completed review, when it is viewed, then its result is recorded for the application.

requirement_text: System shall be able to allow customers to apply for loans and check their application status.
user_story: As a customer, I want to apply for loans and check my application status, so that I can follow my application.
technical_task: Provide loan application and application status checking.
acceptance_criteria: Given the loan application form, when the customer submits an application, then it is saved.
Given a submitted application, when the customer checks the status, then the current status is shown.

requirement_text: System shall adopt a flexible service-based architecture to support future expansion and scalability.
user_story: As a system architect, I want a flexible service-based architecture, so that the system can expand and scale in the future.
technical_task: Adopt a service-based architecture so that new services can be added and capacity scaled.
acceptance_criteria: Given the architecture description, when it is reviewed, then the system is built from services.
Given a new service is needed, when it is added, then existing services need little or no change.
rationale: Role assumed: system architect. "Flexible" is not measured.

requirement_text: This interface shall be closely discussed with daimler MetaCore responsible and should be agreed by MetaCore responsible from OEM.
rationale: The sentence describes a discussion and agreement process and states no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Who is the MetaCore responsible and which interface is meant?
What must the interface do and by when must agreement be reached?

requirement_text: The website shall utilize HTTPS protocol to enhance security during data transmission.
user_story: As a user, I want the website to use HTTPS, so that my data is protected in transit.
technical_task: Serve the website over the HTTPS protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Given the website, when a user opens it, then the connection uses HTTPS.
Given data sent by a user, when it is transmitted, then it is sent over HTTPS.

requirement_text: An API User shall be able to identify Data Publishers.
user_story: As an API user, I want to identify Data Publishers, so that I know who published data.
technical_task: Offer an API function that identifies Data Publishers.
acceptance_criteria: Given published data, when the API user asks who published it, then the Data Publisher is identified.
Given several Data Publishers, when the API user lists them, then each is identified.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to clear all assignments for a particular class.
user_story: As a teacher, I want to clear all assignments for a particular class, so that I can reset it.
technical_task: Add a function that removes every assignment of a chosen class.
acceptance_criteria: Given a class with assignments, when the user clears all assignments, then none remain for that class.
Given another class, when the user clears one class, then the other class's assignments are unchanged.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall , if alignment is permitted, serially incorporate two new channels if they are powered on simultaneously.
requirement_text_raw: 2.     Redundancy Management shall [SRS236], if alignment is permitted, serially incorporate two new channels if they are powered on simultaneously.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to incorporate two newly powered channels one after the other when alignment is permitted, so that they join in order.
technical_task: When alignment is permitted and two new channels are powered on at the same time, incorporate them serially.
acceptance_criteria: Given alignment is permitted and two new channels are powered on simultaneously, when Redundancy Management incorporates them, then it incorporates them one after another.
Given alignment is not permitted, when two new channels are powered on, then this requirement does not apply.

requirement_text: The system shall allow for user ID and password input.
user_story: As a user, I want to enter my user ID and password, so that I can sign in.
technical_task: Provide input fields for user ID and password.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen, when the user opens it, then fields for user ID and password are shown.
Given the fields, when the user enters a user ID and password, then they are accepted as input.

requirement_text: The system shall be available at all times, allowing user access via a web browser, except during server downtime.
user_story: As a user, I want the system available at all times through a web browser, except during server downtime, so that I can use it whenever needed.
technical_task: Keep the system continuously available through a web browser outside of server downtime.
acceptance_criteria: Given the server is up, when a user opens the system in a web browser, then it is available.
Given server downtime, when a user opens the system, then unavailability is accepted as the stated exception.

requirement_text: System shall be available at all times, with downtime limited to server maintenance.
user_story: As a user, I want the system available at all times, with downtime only for server maintenance, so that I can rely on it.
technical_task: Keep the system available continuously and limit downtime to server maintenance windows.
acceptance_criteria: Given normal operation, when a user opens the system, then it is available.
Given downtime occurs, when its cause is checked, then it was for server maintenance.
rationale: Role assumed: user. No availability percentage is given.

requirement_text: The nearest object to estimated vehicle path has the nearest lateral position to the estimated vehicle path but is still on the left lane.
rationale: The sentence defines which object counts as nearest and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must the sensor do with the nearest object to the estimated vehicle path?
Is this a definition of a term rather than a requirement?

requirement_text: The system shall offer comprehensive online help and documentation for users of all skill levels.
rationale: "Comprehensive" and "all skill levels" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What topics and formats must the online help and documentation cover?
How is "comprehensive" and "all skill levels" measured?

requirement_text: The system shall be multilingual, supporting English, Turkish, Finnish, and Italian for international deployment.
user_story: As an international user, I want the system in English, Turkish, Finnish or Italian, so that I can use my language.
technical_task: Support the languages English, Turkish, Finnish and Italian.
acceptance_criteria: Given the language selection, when the user chooses Turkish, Finnish or Italian, then the interface is shown in that language.
Given the language selection, when the user chooses English, then the interface is shown in English.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to import Data Packages into various platforms like Node.js, Julia, R, Excel, SPSS, STATA, LibreOffice/OpenOffice, Python, Clojure, C++.
user_story: As a data scientist, I want to import Data Packages into Node.js, Julia, R, Excel, SPSS, STATA, LibreOffice/OpenOffice, Python, Clojure and C++, so that I can use them in my tools.
technical_task: Provide import of Data Packages into platforms including Node.js, Julia, R, Excel, SPSS, STATA, LibreOffice/OpenOffice, Python, Clojure and C++.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Data Package, when the user imports it into a listed platform such as Python or R, then the data is available there.
Given a Data Package, when the user imports it into Excel, SPSS, STATA or LibreOffice/OpenOffice, then the data is available there.
rationale: Role assumed: data scientist. "Like" means the list may not be complete.

requirement_text: Frequently-executed transactions must be completed with minimal interactions.
clarification_questions: How many interactions count as "minimal"?
Which transactions are "frequently executed"?

requirement_text: The FTPP shall be capable of restoring a corrected faulty computer into the flight critical computer set.
requirement_text_raw: The FTPP shall (3.1.12) be capable of restoring a corrected faulty computer into the flight critical computer set.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTPP to restore a corrected faulty computer into the flight critical computer set, so that redundancy is regained.
technical_task: Support restoring a computer that was faulty and has been corrected into the flight critical computer set.
acceptance_criteria: Given a faulty computer that has been corrected, when the FTPP restores it, then it is part of the flight critical computer set again.
Given a computer that has not been corrected, when the FTPP checks it, then it is not restored.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to add the Classroom number for the class.
user_story: As a teacher, I want to add the Classroom number for a class, so that students know where it takes place.
technical_task: Add a Classroom number field to the class record.
acceptance_criteria: Given a class, when the user enters a Classroom number, then it is saved with the class.
Given a saved class, when it is viewed, then the Classroom number is shown.

requirement_text: VS Code shall be downloadable as a file smaller than 200 MB.
user_story: As a developer, I want VS Code to be downloadable as a file smaller than 200 MB, so that the download is manageable.
technical_task: Package VS Code for download as a single file smaller than 200 MB.
acceptance_criteria: Given the VS Code download, when its file size is checked, then the size is smaller than 200 MB.
Given the download page, when a user downloads VS Code, then it is delivered as a file.
rationale: Role assumed: developer. The size limit of 200 MB is taken from the requirement.

requirement_text: The predicted power shall be based on the worst cell with the lowest voltage.
user_story: As a battery engineer, I want the predicted power to be based on the worst cell with the lowest voltage, so that the prediction is conservative.
technical_task: Compute predicted power from the cell with the lowest voltage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a battery with cells at different voltages, when predicted power is calculated, then it is based on the cell with the lowest voltage.
Given the cell with the lowest voltage changes, when predicted power is calculated again, then it uses the new lowest cell.

requirement_text: User shall have the option to customize the layout and appearance of their Gmail inbox.
user_story: As a Gmail user, I want to customize the layout and appearance of my inbox, so that it looks the way I prefer.
technical_task: Provide options to customize the layout and appearance of the Gmail inbox.
acceptance_criteria: Given the inbox, when the user changes a layout option, then the inbox layout is updated.
Given the inbox, when the user changes an appearance option, then the inbox appearance is updated.

requirement_text: The system shall use industry-standard, commonly available, and widely used operating system, message passing middleware, and programming languages.
rationale: "Industry-standard, commonly available and widely used" are not specific or measurable.
clarification_questions: Which operating system, middleware and programming languages are meant?
What makes something "industry-standard" and "widely used"?

requirement_text: In cases of faults such as incorrect polarity, overvoltage, short circuits, etc. the component must not be damaged.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the component not to be damaged by faults such as incorrect polarity, overvoltage and short circuits, so that it survives wiring mistakes.
technical_task: Protect the component against incorrect polarity, overvoltage, short circuits and similar faults.
acceptance_criteria: Given incorrect polarity, when it is applied to the component, then the component is not damaged.
Given an overvoltage or a short circuit, when it is applied, then the component is not damaged.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. "Etc." means other faults may be covered.

requirement_text: These additional non-functional requirements aim to further enhance the performance, security, user experience, reliability, and availability of the system.
rationale: The sentence describes the aim of other requirements and states none itself.
clarification_questions: Which non-functional requirements does "these additional" point to?
What measurable targets are meant for performance, security, reliability and availability?

requirement_text: User shall be able to create, update, and delete archival descriptions in their repository.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to create, update and delete archival descriptions in my repository, so that I can keep them current.
technical_task: Implement create, update and delete operations for archival descriptions in the user's repository.
acceptance_criteria: Given a repository, when the user creates an archival description, then it is saved in the repository.
Given an archival description, when the user updates it, then the changes are saved.
Given an archival description, when the user deletes it, then it is removed from the repository.

requirement_text: Adobe Illustrator shall not be installed on a volume with a case-sensitive file system.
user_story: As an IT administrator, I want Adobe Illustrator not installed on a case-sensitive file system volume, so that it runs correctly.
technical_task: Prevent the installation of Adobe Illustrator on a volume that uses a case-sensitive file system.
acceptance_criteria: Given a volume with a case-sensitive file system, when the user installs Adobe Illustrator on it, then the installation is not allowed.
Given a volume without a case-sensitive file system, when the user installs Adobe Illustrator, then the installation is allowed.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall report rate group over-runs to the application via an API service for incorporation in the telemetry data stream.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS029] report rate group over-runs to the application via an API service for incorporation in the telemetry data stream.
user_story: As an application developer, I want the scheduler to report rate group over-runs through an API service, so that over-runs appear in the telemetry data stream.
technical_task: Expose rate group over-runs to the application through a scheduler API service so they can be added to the telemetry stream.
acceptance_criteria: Given a rate group over-run, when the scheduler detects it, then it reports it to the application through an API service.
Given the reported over-run, when the application builds telemetry, then it can be incorporated in the telemetry data stream.

requirement_text: The flight NE shall be designed to be capable of complying with all the performance requirements specified herein while non-operating in an atmosphere of 8 to 18 Psia.
requirement_text_raw: The flight NE shall (3.2.3.1.3.6.1) be designed to be capable of complying with all the performance requirements specified herein while non-operating in an atmosphere of 8 to 18 Psia.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the flight NE to comply with all performance requirements after non-operating exposure to an atmosphere of 8 to 18 Psia, so that it survives storage and transport.
technical_task: Design the flight NE to meet all performance requirements after being non-operating in an atmosphere of 8 to 18 Psia.
acceptance_criteria: Given the flight NE has been non-operating at 8 Psia, when it is tested, then it complies with the performance requirements.
Given the flight NE has been non-operating at 18 Psia, when it is tested, then it complies with the performance requirements.

requirement_text: The FCP shall configure ICP simplex virtual groups for each channel in the FCP virtual group.
requirement_text_raw: The FCP shall [SRS296] configure ICP simplex virtual groups for each channel in the FCP virtual group.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FCP to configure ICP simplex virtual groups for each channel in the FCP virtual group, so that each channel has its virtual group.
technical_task: Configure one ICP simplex virtual group on the FCP for every channel in the FCP virtual group.
acceptance_criteria: Given a channel in the FCP virtual group, when the FCP configures the ICPs, then an ICP simplex virtual group is configured for it.
Given several channels in the FCP virtual group, when the FCP configures the ICPs, then each channel has its own ICP simplex virtual group.

requirement_text: The system shall validate data integrity and format compliance during ingest.
user_story: As a data steward, I want data integrity and format compliance validated at ingest, so that bad data is caught early.
technical_task: Validate the integrity and format compliance of data when it is ingested.
acceptance_criteria: Given data being ingested, when it is checked, then its integrity is validated.
Given data in an invalid format, when it is ingested, then it fails format compliance.
